scope: Combined local mechanism/load control with deterministic perception substitute; not live LLM semantic quality or baseline superiority.

hardware.contention: Other frozen campaigns active; wall performance is not an isolated machine benchmark.

corpusManifest.reportingPolicy: Physical need at time zero; public source followed by the same delayed formal report for every arm. Source interpretation alone does not authorize a dispatch.
corpusManifest.limitation: Internally authored synthetic cohort. Formal delay and human throughput require sensitivity tests; they are not field measurements.

providerSubstitute.inputScope: Only actual received SemanticIngestion user payload; public sources and public directory.
providerSubstitute.interpretation: Conventional public parser, not gold labels or prerecorded correct answers.

collective.note: Operating hours alone are not useful service. Occupied shelter place-hours and finite water production are measured separately.

platformTransport.note: Actual platform peer HTTP is charged by the laboratory transport adapter; this is distinct from source-system messages.

information.note: These counts cover source-world claims only, not claims in an external platform database. Workflow acknowledgments are not semantic accuracy. Platform precision/recall requires matched external claims and independent task annotations.

firstUsefulServiceMs.note: First physical positive contribution to outstanding demand; partial service counts here, but not as sufficient service. Report firstUsefulRightCensored separately.

sufficientServiceMs.note: Sufficient physical service, completed positive-demand cases only; report right-censored cases alongside these percentiles.

needToServiceMs.note: Sufficient physical service, completed positive-demand cases only; report right-censored cases alongside these percentiles.

episodes.note: A new outstanding shortfall after coverage or retirement starts a new episode. Earlier aid is retained in history, never credited as response to a new episode. Withdrawn episodes are censored at withdrawal and must be reported separately; native resource quantities and integrals are not summed across types.

limitations: No real model or paid calls; this verifies integration, finite queues and service causality, not semantic accuracy/cost/throughput of Gemma or Gemini.
Four independent in-memory databases in one OS process, not four durable processes.
Review uses the same competent scripted owner and finite source slots/duration as the harness; no human comprehension claim.
Pending interpretations reported explicitly. If wall limit interrupts, later physical completion is retained but no new controller decisions occur.
No comparative gain claimed and no clinical/mortality model. Fixed internally authored informational cohort; hardware contention declared.
